proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4661 candra includes Gujarati cā̃d/cā̃do moon, Assamese sā̃d and Sindhi caṇḍru. The western survey s-initial and retroflex-cluster variants fit this documented moon family; regional transmission remains open. Exact survey form sānd is retained.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5070 *chokara gives Gujarati choro/chori and Hindi chora/chori boy/girl, with Assamese sora. The Bhil s-/ts- forms preserve the k-less stem and gender endings; child and daughter are compatible survey kinship senses. Exact survey form sorā̃ is retained.
